results.name: All ten names and real encounter parts follow the reference; late health scales for the faster pod
Old Sunny blocks plain seeds asleep; his bubble wakes a six-second double-damage window
Sunny warns before an early two-sprout volley; ignoring the whole pair costs exactly one life
Two ordinary aimed seeds can stop Sunny’s whole volley before it takes a life
Lullaby freezes Sunny’s launched sprouts and defeat cancels them with the normal finale
Every authored boss has a unique ordinary-flower change after its complete visible tell
Sunny growth and Root shrink change the actual seed collider, with no tiny target
Crystal sways real colliders, Lily lifts flowers safely, and Lullaby holds effect phase and deadlines
Temporary fields restore on expiry, near-line entry, boss breach and defeat without changing saved health damage
Thornmother converts a whole clean group, regrows it through the engine, then clears temporary timers
Geode cannot keep adding rings to the same bud, and Core echoes never copy echoes or exceed four total
Modifier selection excludes special pieces and the final reaction margin, and a new wave discards all old effects
Rootknot warns of walls and holes, has no underground collider, and emerges hittable
Mother Morel guards her bonnet underside; a real nearby puffcap deals two damage
Crystal Heart has three colliders and one beating heart; real hits damage and stun
Lantern Lily crits once through her lantern, gutters it five seconds and forms a whirlpool
Ammonite Queen needs the mouth click, then a second aligned ring before taking damage
Ember Rose burns plain seeds, takes tunnel criticals and exposes a warned dive
Ember fire actually consumes a plain seed; tunnel seeds survive and ignition speeds only marked buds
Geode King has eight crust HP; a broken plate opens the heart and regrowth is warned
Thornmother patches heal through heart-vines; a complete patch cuts its vine
The Starseed uses five real stars, a three-star dome, replayed moves and supernova
The Starseed marks every dark or broken satellite before relighting its second phase
Moves wait at least 1.3 seconds for the audible warning; Lullaby holds them and defeat cancels future attacks
Last-life bosses give one free Lullaby bubble; boss-only retry earns at most one star
Paid shot powers retain their exact ring damage and a final multi-hit clears the boss once
Seeded chains obey visible boss armor; Morel puff damage and paid Sunburst remain exceptions
Prediction is read-only and encounters agree at 30, 60 and 144 FPS
Real reinforcements retain broken Geode/Core parts, which revive as hittable colliders
Revival reconnects a detached boss part once, preserving its canonical encounter object
Crystal proxy bodies breach and reset every heart immediately; underground Root remains exempt
Super Bloom cannot turn two-hit boss armor parts into plain pierced flowers
Sunburst takes exactly four rings once per whole guardian through bodies or proxies
Bee Line takes three rings once per whole guardian while opening its encountered guard parts
Real powered seed paths through Crystal hearts and Lily lantern keep the stated whole-boss damage
